tagline: Your documents, kept safe – end to end.
space.name: Name of the space
space.first: Name your first space – a private archive, for example. More can follow.
doc.drop: Drop files here to add them
doc.title: Title
reading.noOcr: This build reads text layers only (aktujo-minimal).
tui.path: Path of a file or folder
tui.title: title
tui.label: label
tui.noSpace: No space yet – press n to found one.
sync.title: Sync and sharing
sync.notYet: This space is only on this device.
sync.relayHint: A relay you run yourself with aktujo relay – on a small server or in your home network. It only ever sees encrypted data.
sync.codeHint: Write it down and keep it safe. It is shown only now: without it and without a device of this space, the space is lost.
sync.never: Not synced since the program started
sync.waiting: This device waits to be added by a device that may manage the space – at that device's next sync.
sync.inviteHint: Your own device or someone else's. The invitation is good for a day; the device is added at the next sync of this one.
sync.removeConfirm: Remove {name}? It gets nothing written after.
sync.readOnly: This device may only read in this space.
settings.deviceNameHint: The other members of a space see it – "Laptop" or "Anna's phone", for example.
settings.joinHint: Paste an invitation you were given.
settings.recoverHint: With its recovery code, when no device of it is left.
tui.rights: Rights: r read, w write, m manage
tui.codeShown: Recovery code – write it down, it is shown only now: {code}
kinds.title: Kinds
kinds.hint: Kinds of documents are yours to define – letters, sheet music, research papers, the books of a collection, anything. Each space has its own; they are shared with its members.
kinds.none: No kinds yet. Add one, or import a template.
kinds.importHint: A template is a JSON file of kinds, e.g. from github.com/aktujo/catalog or exported from another space. Kinds with the same identity are replaced.
kinds.name: Name
kinds.words: Words that speak for this kind
kinds.wordsHint: One per line, optionally with a weight: “isbn = 6”. Without one a word weighs 2; from a sum of 6 the kind is suggested.
kinds.removeConfirm: Remove the kind “{name}”? Its documents keep it.
tui.chooseKindPrompt: Kind (name or identity; empty for none)
tui.importKindsPrompt: Path of a template of kinds (JSON)
catalog.title: Templates from catalogs
catalog.hint: Read now from the sources that are on (settings). Look at what a template would do before you take it over.
catalog.empty: No templates – are the sources switched on?
catalog.notReviewed: From {source} – not reviewed by the aktujo team.
catalog.keepMine: Keep it as it is here
catalog.conflicts: Changed here and in the template – the version here stays:
sources.title: Sources of templates
sources.hint: Catalogs aktujo reads templates from – only when you open one. The official catalog can be switched off.
tui.catalogPrompt: Number of the template to take over
tui.catalogTaken: {n} kinds changed; {conflicts} items changed here and in the template kept as here
tui.watchPrompt: Folder whose new files go into this space (empty: watch none)
tui.watchNone: No folder is watched for this space.
watch.title: Watched folders
watch.hint: New files in a folder of this device – from a scanner, say – are taken into a space on their own: PDF, PNG, JPEG and TIFF, once they are written completely. The folder is looked at every few seconds while aktujo runs; files in folders inside it are left alone.
watch.moveOption: Move taken files into the folder “added” inside it
watch.removeConfirm: Stop watching {folder}? Its files and the documents taken from it stay.
